experiment: R1 precondition probe — capital delivery to a REAL stochastic worker
whyItExists: R1's primary matrix compares C0/C1/C2. That comparison is only meaningful if the three conditions differ in what the WORKER can see. This probe measures exactly that, with the shipped dshSubprocessWorkWorkerPort on a real DSH/deepseek-flash worker.
noteOnDigests: The literal prompt digest includes the per-run H0 base commit, which is a fixture value rather than a condition variable, so the BASE-MASKED digest is the one to compare across conditions. All three are identical.
finding: All three conditions produced a BYTE-IDENTICAL model-visible prompt (identical base-masked digest). The knowledge handles appear in the delivery payload but are rendered into neither the prompt nor any tool the worker may call.
